          /* Optional EmailOutbound */ email, /* Optional GlideRecord */ email_action,
          /* Optional GlideRecord */ event) {
	
	var count = 0;
	var properties = JSON.parse(event.parm2);
	email.setSubject(properties.subject);
	template.print(properties.body);
	
	for(count = 0; count < properties.cc.length; count++) {
		email.addAddress("cc", (properties.cc)[count], (properties.cc)[count]);
	}
	
	for(count = 0; count < properties.bcc.length; count++) {
		email.addAddress("bcc", (properties.bcc)[count], (properties.bcc)[count]);
	}
	
})(current, template, email, email_action, event);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_email</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2022-04-26 11:29:31</sys_created_on><sys_id>a4ff22de07074110a4a2f7108c1ed0ea</sys_id><sys_mod_count>4</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_75740_inform_set_properties</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Inform" source="x_75740_inform">dc0f5e4007830110a4a2f7108c1ed060</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Inform">dc0f5e4007830110a4a2f7108c1ed060</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_email_a4ff22de07074110a4a2f7108c1ed0ea</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2022-04-26 17:47:52</sys_updated_on></sys_script_email></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_75740_inform_pdf_template</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition table="x_75740_inform_pdf_template">template_type=2^EQ<item display_value="PDF Form" endquery="false" field="template_type" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value="2"/><item endquery="true" field="" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value=""/></filter_condition><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>PDF Template: Check for pdf form</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {
	
	var attachment = new GlideRecord("sys_attachment");
	attachment.addEncodedQuery("table_name=x_75740_inform_pdf_template^content_type=application/pdf^table_sys_id=" + current.getValue("sys_id"));
	attachment.query();
	if(attachment.getRowCount() != 1) {
		gs.addErrorMessage("Please add only 1 editable/fillable PDF form.");

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_75740_inform.emailutils</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><name>emailutils</name><script><![CDATA[var emailutils = Class.create();
emailutils.prototype = {
	initialize : function() {
	},
	
	/* getEmailProperties
	************************************************************************************************************
	This function will be called to get the email properties.
	*/
	getEmailProperties : function(emailTemplateSysId, table, recordSysId) {
		var properties = {};
		var template = new GlideRecord("x_75740_inform_email_template");
		template.addEncodedQuery("sys_id=" + emailTemplateSysId);
		template.query();
		if(template.next()) {
			properties.subject = template.getValue("mail_subject");
			properties.body = template.getValue("mail_body");
			properties.to = this.getToRecipients(template, table, recordSysId);
			properties.cc = this.getCcRecipients(template, table, recordSysId);
			properties.bcc = this.getBccRecipients(template, table, recordSysId);
		}
		return properties;
	},
	
	/* getToRecipients
	************************************************************************************************************
	This function will return the email addressess of the recipients.
	*/
	getToRecipients : function(template, table, recordSysId) {
		var emails = [], address;
		var user = new GlideRecord("sys_user");
		user.addEncodedQuery("sys_idIN" + template.getValue("mail_to_users"));
		user.query();
		while(user.next()) {
			address = user.getValue("email");
			if(address != null && address != "undefined" && address != "") {
				emails.push(address);
			}
		}
		
		var group = new GlideRecord("sys_user_group");
		group.addEncodedQuery("sys_idIN" + template.getValue("mail_to_groups"));
		group.query();
		while(group.next()) {
			address = group.getValue("email");
			if(address != null && address != "undefined" && address != "") {
				emails.push(address);
			}
			
			var groupMember = new GlideRecord("sys_user_grmember");
			groupMember.addEncodedQuery("group=" + group.getValue("sys_id"));
			groupMember.query();
			while(groupMember.next()) {
				address = groupMember.user.email + "";
				if(address != null && address != "undefined" && address != "") {
					emails.push(address);
				}
			}
		}
		
		var otherRecipients = template.getValue("mail_to_other_recipients");
		if(otherRecipients != null && otherRecipients != "undefined" && otherRecipients != "") {
			otherRecipients = otherRecipients.split(",");
			for(var count = 0; count < otherRecipients.length; count++) {
				emails.push(otherRecipients[count]);
			}
		}
		
		if(template.getValue("evaluate_to_recipients_using_script") == true) {
			var gr = new GlideRecord(table);
			gr.addEncodedQuery("sys_id=" + recordSysId);
			gr.query();
			if(gr.next()) {
				var evaluator = new GlideScopedEvaluator();
				evaluator.putVariable("result", null);
				evaluator.evaluateScript(template, "script_for_evaluating_to_recipients", {current : gr});
				var result = evaluator.getVariable("result");
				emails = emails.concat(result);
			}
		}
		
		return emails;
	},
	
	/* getCcRecipients
	************************************************************************************************************
	This function will return the email addressess of the recipients.
	*/
	getCcRecipients : function(template, table, recordSysId) {
		var emails = [], address;
		var user = new GlideRecord("sys_user");
		user.addEncodedQuery("sys_idIN" + template.getValue("mail_cc_users"));
		user.query();
		while(user.next()) {
			address = user.getValue("email");
			if(address != null && address != "undefined" && address != "") {
				emails.push(address);
			}
		}
		
		var group = new GlideRecord("sys_user_group");
		group.addEncodedQuery("sys_idIN" + template.getValue("mail_cc_groups"));
		group.query();
		while(group.next()) {
			address = group.getValue("email");
			if(address != null && address != "undefined" && address != "") {
				emails.push(address);
			}
			
			var groupMember = new GlideRecord("sys_user_grmember");
			groupMember.addEncodedQuery("group=" + group.getValue("sys_id"));
			groupMember.query();
			while(groupMember.next()) {
				address = groupMember.user.email + "";
				if(address != null && address != "undefined" && address != "") {
					emails.push(address);
				}
			}
		}
		
		var otherRecipients = template.getValue("mail_cc_other_recipients");
		if(otherRecipients != null && otherRecipients != "undefined" && otherRecipients != "") {
			otherRecipients = otherRecipients.split(",");
			for(var count = 0; count < otherRecipients.length; count++) {
				emails.push(otherRecipients[count]);
			}
		}
		
		if(template.getValue("evaluate_cc_recipients_using_script") == true) {
			var gr = new GlideRecord(table);
			gr.addEncodedQuery("sys_id=" + recordSysId);
			gr.query();
			if(gr.next()) {
				var evaluator = new GlideScopedEvaluator();
				evaluator.putVariable("result", null);
				evaluator.evaluateScript(template, "script_for_evaluating_cc_recipients", {current : gr});
				var result = evaluator.getVariable("result");
				emails = emails.concat(result);
			}
		}
		
		return emails;
	},
	
	/* getBccRecipients
	************************************************************************************************************
	This function will return the email addressess of the recipients.
	*/
	getBccRecipients : function(template, table, recordSysId) {
		var emails = [], address;
		var user = new GlideRecord("sys_user");
		user.addEncodedQuery("sys_idIN" + template.getValue("mail_bcc_users"));
		user.query();
		while(user.next()) {
			address = user.getValue("email");
			if(address != null && address != "undefined" && address != "") {
				emails.push(address);
			}
		}
		
		var group = new GlideRecord("sys_user_group");
		group.addEncodedQuery("sys_idIN" + template.getValue("mail_bcc_groups"));
		group.query();
		while(group.next()) {
			address = group.getValue("email");
			if(address != null && address != "undefined" && address != "") {
				emails.push(address);
			}
			
			var groupMember = new GlideRecord("sys_user_grmember");
			groupMember.addEncodedQuery("group=" + group.getValue("sys_id"));
			groupMember.query();
			while(groupMember.next()) {
				address = groupMember.user.email + "";
				if(address != null && address != "undefined" && address != "") {
					emails.push(address);
				}
			}
		}
		
		var otherRecipients = template.getValue("mail_bcc_other_recipients");
		if(otherRecipients != null && otherRecipients != "undefined" && otherRecipients != "") {
			otherRecipients = otherRecipients.split(",");
			for(var count = 0; count < otherRecipients.length; count++) {
				emails.push(otherRecipients[count]);
			}
		}
		
		if(template.getValue("evaluate_bcc_recipients_using_script") == true) {
			var gr = new GlideRecord(table);
			gr.addEncodedQuery("sys_id=" + recordSysId);
			gr.query();
			if(gr.next()) {
				var evaluator = new GlideScopedEvaluator();
				evaluator.putVariable("result", null);
				evaluator.evaluateScript(template, "script_for_evaluating_bcc_recipients", {current : gr});
				var result = evaluator.getVariable("result");
				emails = emails.concat(result);
			}
		}
		
		return emails;
	},
	
	type : 'emailutils'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2022-04-26 09:55:47</sys_created_on><sys_id>160b5e9a07c34110a4a2f7108c1ed0db</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>emailutils</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Inform" source="x_75740_inform">dc0f5e4007830110a4a2f7108c1ed060</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Inform">dc0f5e4007830110a4a2f7108c1ed060</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_160b5e9a07c34110a4a2f7108c1ed0db</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2022-04-26 11:23:22</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_75740_inform.pdfutils</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><name>pdfutils</name><script><![CDATA[var pdfutils = Class.create();
pdfutils.prototype = {
	initialize: function() {
	},
	
	/* retrieveFields
	************************************************************************************************************
	This function will be called to delete the existing fields and recreate new fields.
	*/
	retrieveFields : function(templateSysId) {
		this.deleteFields(templateSysId);
		
		var template = new GlideRecord("x_75740_inform_pdf_template");
		template.addEncodedQuery("active=true^sys_id=" + templateSysId);
		template.query();
		if(template.next()) {
			var fields = [], count = 0, fieldTypes = {}, options = "";
			if(template.getValue("template_type") == "1") {
				var htmlTemplate = template.getValue("html_template");
				fields = htmlTemplate.match(/\${(\w*)}/gi);
				for(count = 0; count < fields.length; count++) {
					this.insertField(fields[count].replace("${", "").replace("}", ""), "text", options, template.getValue("table"), templateSysId);
				}
			} else {
				var attachment = new GlideRecord("sys_attachment");
				attachment.addEncodedQuery("table_name=x_75740_inform_pdf_template^content_type=application/pdf^table_sys_id=" + templateSysId);
				attachment.query();
				if(attachment.next()) {
					var v = new sn_pdfgeneratorutils.PDFGenerationAPI;
					var result = v.isDocumentFillable(attachment.getValue("sys_id"));
					if(result.document_editable == "true") {
						v.getDocumentFields(attachment.getValue("sys_id"));
						result = v.getDocumentFieldsType(attachment.getValue("sys_id"));
						fields = result.fields;
						fieldTypes = result.fields_type;
						for(count = 0; count < fields.length; count++) {
							var fo = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(fieldTypes, fields[count]).value;
							var type = fo.type;
							options = "";
							
							if(type == "check_box" || type == "choice_box" || type == "combo_box" || type == "multi_select_choice_box") {
								var fd = fo.fieldsDetails;
								for(var optionsCount = 0; optionsCount < fd.length; optionsCount++) {
									options = options + ((options == "") ? "" : ", ") + fd[optionsCount].fieldName;
								}
							}
							this.insertField(fields[count], type, options, template.getValue("table"), templateSysId);
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	},
	
	/* deleteFields
	************************************************************************************************************
	This function will be called to delete fields associated with the template.
	*/
	deleteFields : function(templateSysId) {
		var pdfFields = new GlideRecord("x_75740_inform_pdf_fields");
		pdfFields.addEncodedQuery("template=" + templateSysId);
		pdfFields.query();
		pdfFields.deleteMultiple();
	},
	
	/* insertField
	************************************************************************************************************
	This function will be called to insert a new field and associate the same with a template.
	*/
	insertField : function(name, type, options, table, templateSysId) {
		var pdfField = new GlideRecord("x_75740_inform_pdf_fields");
		pdfField.initialize();
		pdfField.setValue("name", name);
		pdfField.setValue("type", type);
		pdfField.setValue("options", options);
		pdfField.setValue("table", table);
		pdfField.setValue("template", templateSysId);
		pdfField.insert();
	},
	
	/* createPDF
	************************************************************************************************************
	This function will be called to initiate the creation of PDF file.
	*/
	createPDF : function(templateSysId, record) {
		var template = new GlideRecord("x_75740_inform_pdf_template");
		template.addEncodedQuery("active=true^sys_id=" + templateSysId);
		template.query();
		if(template.next()) {
			if(!this.evaluateCondition(template, record)) {
				return;
			}
			
			this.executePreScript(template, record);
			
			var pdf = new sn_pdfgeneratorutils.PDFGenerationAPI;
			var fileName = this.fileName(template, record);
			var result = null;
			
			if(template.getValue("template_type") == "1") {
				var html = this.evaluateHTMLFieldValue(templateSysId, template.getValue("html_template"), record);
				var headerFooterInfo = this.configureHeaderFooterInfoObject(template);
				result = pdf.convertToPDFWithHeaderFooter(html, template.getValue("table"), record.getValue("sys_id"), fileName, headerFooterInfo);
			} else {
				var attachment = new GlideRecord("sys_attachment");
				attachment.addEncodedQuery("table_name=x_75740_inform_pdf_template^content_type=application/pdf^table_sys_id=" + templateSysId);
				attachment.query();
				if(attachment.next()) {
					var fieldMap = this.createFieldMap(templateSysId, record);
					result = pdf.fillDocumentFields(fieldMap, attachment.getValue("sys_id"), template.getValue("table"), record.getValue("sys_id"), fileName);
				}
			}
			
			this.executePostScript(template, record);
			
			if(result.status == "success") {
				this.createFileInstanceRecord(template, record, "pdf", result);
			}
		}
	},
	
	/* evaluateCondition
	************************************************************************************************************
	This function will be called to determine whether the current record passes the filter criteria mentioned in the template.
	*/
	evaluateCondition : function(template, record) {
		var result = false;
		if(template.getValue("evaluate_condition_using_script") == true) {
			var evaluator = new GlideScopedEvaluator();
			evaluator.putVariable("result", result);
			evaluator.evaluateScript(template, "script_for_evaluating_the_condition", {current : record});
			result = evaluator.getVariable("result");
			result = (typeof result == "boolean") ? result : false;
		} else {
			if(template.getValue("condition") != null) {
				var gr = new GlideRecord(template.getValue("table"));
				gr.addEncodedQuery("sys_id=" + record.getValue("sys_id") + "^" + template.getValue("condition"));
				gr.query();
				result = (gr.getRowCount() == 1) ? true : false;
			} else {
				result = true;
			}
		}
		return result;
	},
	
	/* executePreScript
	************************************************************************************************************
	This function will execute the "Pre-Script" as defined in the template.
	*/
	executePreScript : function(template, record) {
		if(template.getValue("execute_pre_script") == true) {
			var evaluator = new GlideScopedEvaluator();
			evaluator.evaluateScript(template, "pre_script", {current : record});
		}
	},
	
	/* executePostScript
	************************************************************************************************************
	This function will execute the "Post-Script" as defined in the template.
	*/
	executePostScript : function(template, record) {
		if(template.getValue("execute_post_script") == true) {
			var evaluator = new GlideScopedEvaluator();
			evaluator.evaluateScript(template, "post_script", {current : record});
		}
	},
	
	/* fileName
	************************************************************************************************************
	This function will be called to generte the name of the file.
	*/
	fileName : function(template, record) {
		var fileName = template.getValue("default_file_name"), result = null;
		if(template.getValue("generate_filename_using_script") == true) {
			var evaluator = new GlideScopedEvaluator();
			evaluator.putVariable("result", result);
			evaluator.evaluateScript(template, "script_for_generating_the_filename", {current : record});
			result = evaluator.getVariable("result");
			fileName = (result != null && result != "undefined" && result != "") ? result : fileName;
		}
		return fileName;
	},
	
	/* evaluateHTMLFieldValue
	************************************************************************************************************
	This function will be called to evaluate the field values.
	*/
	evaluateHTMLFieldValue : function(templateSysId, htmlTemplate, record) {
		var html = htmlTemplate, value = "";
		var field = new GlideRecord("x_75740_inform_pdf_fields");
		field.addEncodedQuery("template=" + templateSysId);
		field.query();
		while(field.next()) {
			if(field.getValue("evaluate_value_using_script") == true) {
				var evaluator = new GlideScopedEvaluator();
				evaluator.putVariable("result", null);
				evaluator.evaluateScript(field, "script_to_evaluate_the_value", {current : record});
				value = evaluator.getVariable("result");
			} else {
				value = record.getDisplayValue(field.getValue("field"));
			}
			html = html.replaceAll("${" + field.getValue("name") + "}", value);
		}
		return html;
	},
	
	/* createFieldMap
	************************************************************************************************************
	This function will create and return the field map which will be utilized to populate the fields in the editable/fillable PDF.
	*/
	createFieldMap : function(templateSysId, record) {
		var fieldMap = {}, value = "";
		var field = new GlideRecord("x_75740_inform_pdf_fields");
		field.addEncodedQuery("template=" + templateSysId);
		field.query();
		while(field.next()) {
			if(field.getValue("evaluate_value_using_script") == true) {
				var evaluator = new GlideScopedEvaluator();
				evaluator.putVariable("result", null);
				evaluator.evaluateScript(field, "script_to_evaluate_the_value", {current : record});
				value = evaluator.getVariable("result");
			} else {
				value = record.getDisplayValue(field.getValue("field"));
			}
			fieldMap[field.getValue("name")] = value;
		}
		return fieldMap;
	},
	
	/* configureHeaderFooterInfoObject
	************************************************************************************************************
	This function will be called to configure header & footer info object which will be utilized while generating the PDF file.
	*/
	configureHeaderFooterInfoObject : function(template) {
		var hf = {};
		hf.PageSize = template.getValue("page_size");
		hf.PageOrientation = template.getValue("page_orientation");
		hf.GeneratePageNumber = template.getValue("generate_page_number");
		hf.LeftOrRightMargin = template.getValue("left_right_margins");
		hf.TopOrBottomMargin = template.getValue("top_bottom_margins");
		
		if(template.getValue("header_footer") != null && template.getValue("header_footer") != "undefined" && template.getValue("header_footer") != "") {
			hf.HeaderImageAlignment = template.header_footer.header_image_alignment + "";
			hf.HeaderImageHeight = template.header_footer.header_image_height + "";
			hf.HeaderImageAttachmentId = template.header_footer.header_image + "";
			hf.FooterImageAlignment = template.header_footer.footer_image_alignment + "";
			hf.FooterImageHeight = template.header_footer.footer_image_height + "";
			hf.FooterImageAttachmentId = template.header_footer.footer_image + "";
			hf.FooterText = template.header_footer.footer_text + "";
			hf.FooterTextAlignment = template.header_footer.footer_text_alignment + "";
		}
		
		return hf;
	},
	
	/* createFileInstanceRecord
	************************************************************************************************************
	This function will be called to create a "File Instance Record".
	*/
	createFileInstanceRecord : function(template, record, type, result) {
		var gr = new GlideRecord("x_75740_inform_file_instance_record");
		gr.initialize();
		gr.setValue("type", type);
		gr.setValue("template_sys_id", template.getValue("sys_id"));
		gr.setValue("table", template.getValue("table"));
		gr.setValue("email_template", template.getValue("email_template"));
		gr.setValue("record_sys_id", record.getValue("sys_id"));
		gr.setValue("attachment_sys_id", result.attachment_id);
		gr.setValue("share_generated_file_over_email", template.getValue("share_the_generated_file_over_email"));
		gr.insert();
	},
	
	/* executeSchedule
	************************************************************************************************************
	This function will be called to execute a schedule to generate PDF(s).
	*/
	executeSchedule : function(templateSysId) {
		var sysIds = [], query = "";
		var template = new GlideRecord("x_75740_inform_pdf_template");
		template.addEncodedQuery("sys_id=" + templateSysId);
		template.query();
		if(template.next()) {
			if(template.getValue("filter_records_using_script") == true) {
				var evaluator = new GlideScopedEvaluator();
				evaluator.putVariable("result", null);
				evaluator.evaluateScript(template, "script_to_filter_the_records", {template : template});
				sysIds = evaluator.getVariable("result");
				query = "sys_idIN" + sysIds.toString();
			} else {
				query = template.getValue("filter");
			}
			
			var gr = new GlideRecord(template.getValue("table"));
			gr.addEncodedQuery(query);
			gr.query();
			while(gr.next()) {
				this.createPDF(templateSysId, gr);
			}
		}
	},
	
	type: 'pdfutils'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2022-04-25 13:54:20</sys_created_on><sys_id>f2a6820207070110a4a2f7108c1ed052</sys_id><sys_mod_count>40</sys_mod_count><sys_name>pdfutils</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Inform" source="x_75740_inform">dc0f5e4007830110a4a2f7108c1ed060</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Inform">dc0f5e4007830110a4a2f7108c1ed060</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_f2a6820207070110a4a2f7108c1ed052</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2022-05-16 13:43:27</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_include_98133c7d07e30110a4a2f7108c1ed021
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_75740_inform.excelutils</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><name>excelutils</name><script><![CDATA[var excelutils = Class.create();
excelutils.prototype = {
	initialize: function() {
	},
	
	/* getExcelData
	************************************************************************************************************
	This function will gather the data from different sources and return the same as JSON.
	
	Response -
	{
		fileName : <string>,
		sheets : [{
			sheetName : <string>,
			headers : [{
				id : <string>,
				label : <string>
			}],
			rows : [[{
				header : <string>,
				value : <object>
			}]],
			count : <integer>
		}]
	}
	*/
	getExcelData : function(templateSysId) {
		var excelDate = {};
		
		var template = new GlideRecord("x_75740_inform_excel_template");
		template.addEncodedQuery("sys_id=" + templateSysId);
		template.query();
		if(template.next()) {
			excelDate.fileName = template.getValue("file_name_default");
		}
		
		excelDate.sheets = [];
		var sheets = new GlideRecord("x_75740_inform_excel_sheet");
		sheets.addEncodedQuery("template=" + templateSysId + "^active=true");
		sheets.orderBy("order");
		sheets.query();
		while(sheets.next()) {
			var sheetData = {};
			sheetData.sheetName = sheets.getValue("name");
			sheetData.headerCount = this.getHeaderCount(sheets);
			sheetData.rows = this.getSheetRows(sheets);
			sheetData.count = sheetData.rows.length;
			excelDate.sheets.push(sheetData);
		}
		return excelDate;
	},
	
	/* getHeaderCount
	************************************************************************************************************
	This function will return the count of the headers associated with a sheet.
	*/
	getHeaderCount : function(sheet) {
		var gr = new GlideRecord("x_75740_inform_excel_column");
		gr.addEncodedQuery("sheet=" + sheet.getValue("sys_id") + "^active=true");
		gr.query();
		return gr.getRowCount();
	},
	
	/* getSheetRows
	************************************************************************************************************
	This function will return rows of sheet.
	*/
	getSheetRows : function(sheet) {
		var records = {}, rows = [], result = {};
		
		this.getSheetHeaders(sheet.getValue("sys_id"), rows);
		
		if(sheet.getValue("filter_records_using_the_script") == true) {
			var evaluator = new GlideScopedEvaluator();
			evaluator.putVariable("result", result);
			evaluator.evaluateScript(sheet, "script_to_filter_the_records", {sheet : sheet});
			result = evaluator.getVariable("result");
			
			records = new GlideRecord(sheet.getValue("table"));
			records.addEncodedQuery("sys_idIN" + result.toString());
			records.query();
			while(records.next()) {
				rows.push(this.getRowData(sheet, records));
			}
		} else {
			records = new GlideRecord(sheet.getValue("table"));
			records.addEncodedQuery(sheet.getValue("filter"));
			records.query();
			while(records.next()) {
				rows.push(this.getRowData(sheet, records));
			}
		}
		return rows;
	},
	
	/* getSheetHeaders
	************************************************************************************************************
	This function will return the headers associated with the field.
	*/
	getSheetHeaders : function(sheetSysId, rows) {
		var headers = [];
		var gr = new GlideRecord("x_75740_inform_excel_column");
		gr.addEncodedQuery("sheet=" + sheetSysId + "^active=true");
		gr.orderBy("order");
		gr.query();
		while(gr.next()) {
			var columnObject = {};
			columnObject.id = gr.getValue("sys_id");
			columnObject.value = gr.getValue("name");
			headers.push(columnObject);
		}
		rows.push(headers);
	},
	
	/* getRowData
	************************************************************************************************************
	This function will return the row data.
	*/
	getRowData : function(sheet, current) {
		var rowData = [];
		var gr = new GlideRecord("x_75740_inform_excel_column");
		gr.addEncodedQuery("sheet=" + sheet.getValue("sys_id") + "^active=true");
		gr.orderBy("order");
		gr.query();
		while(gr.next()) {
			var columnObject = {};
			columnObject.id = gr.getValue("sys_id");
			if(gr.getValue("evaluate_script_for_the_column_value") == true) {
				var result = {};
				var evaluator = new GlideScopedEvaluator();
				evaluator.putVariable("result", result);
				evaluator.evaluateScript(gr, "script_to_evaluate_the_column_value", {current : current});
				columnObject.value = evaluator.getVariable("result");
			} else {
				columnObject.value = current.getValue(gr.getValue("field"));
			}
			rowData.push(columnObject);
		}
		return rowData;
	},
	
	type : 'excelutils'

})(current);]]></calculation><choice/><choice_field/><choice_table/><column_label>Script (for evaluating the condition)</column_label><comments/><create_roles/><default_value>/*
The current record can be accessed via the "current" object.
The script must return a boolean value in the "result" object.

e.g. -
if(current.getValue("sys_id") == -1) {
result = true;
} else {
result = false;
}

If both the condition and the script is defined then the script will take the precedence over the condition.

	var gr = new GlideRecord("sys_attachment");
	gr.addEncodedQuery("sys_id=" + current.getValue("attachment_sys_id"));
	gr.query();
	if(gr.next()) {
		var attachment = new GlideSysAttachment();
		attachment.write(current, gr.getValue("file_name"), gr.getValue("content_type"), attachment.getContent(gr));
	}
	
})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2022-04-26 12:19:46</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>385bb25a07474110a4a2f7108c1ed09a</sys_id><sys_mod_count>5</sys_mod_count><sys_name>FIR: Copy attachment</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Inform" source="x_75740_inform">dc0f5e4007830110a4a2f7108c1ed060</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Inform">dc0f5e4007830110a4a2f7108c1ed060</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_385bb25a07474110a4a2f7108c1ed09a</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2022-05-13 17:26:37</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=385bb25a07474110a4a2f7108c1ed09a"/></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_include_5ee832e707db0110a4a2f7108c1ed073
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_75740_inform.ziputils</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><name>ziputils</name><script><![CDATA[var ziputils = Class.create();
ziputils.prototype = {
	
	initialize : function() {
	},
	
	/* createZIP
	************************************************************************************************************
	This function will be called to initiate the creation of ZIP file.
	*/
	createZIP : function(templateSysId, record) {
		var template = new GlideRecord("x_75740_inform_zip_template");
		template.addEncodedQuery("active=true^sys_id=" + templateSysId);
		template.query();
		if(template.next()) {
			if(!this.evaluateCondition(template, record)) {
				return;
			}
			
			this.executePreScript(template, record);
			
			var fileName = this.fileName(template, record) + ".zip";
			var result = new global.informutils().createZIP(template, record, fileName);
			
			this.executePostScript(template, record);
			
			if(result != null) {
				this.createFileInstanceRecord(template, record, "zip", { attachment_id : result });
			}
		}
	},
	
	/* evaluateCondition
	************************************************************************************************************
	This function will be called to determine whether the current record passes the filter criteria mentioned in the template.
	*/
	evaluateCondition : function(template, record) {
		var result = false;
		if(template.getValue("evaluate_condition_using_script") == true) {
			var evaluator = new GlideScopedEvaluator();
			evaluator.putVariable("result", result);
			evaluator.evaluateScript(template, "script_for_evaluating_the_condition", {current : record});
			result = evaluator.getVariable("result");
			result = (typeof result == "boolean") ? result : false;
		} else {
			if(template.getValue("condition") != null) {
				var gr = new GlideRecord(template.getValue("table"));
				gr.addEncodedQuery("sys_id=" + record.getValue("sys_id") + "^" + template.getValue("condition"));
				gr.query();
				result = (gr.getRowCount() == 1) ? true : false;
			} else {
				result = true;
			}
		}
		return result;
	},
	
	/* executePreScript
	************************************************************************************************************
	This function will execute the "Pre-Script" as defined in the template.
	*/
	executePreScript : function(template, record) {
		if(template.getValue("execute_pre_script") == true) {
			var evaluator = new GlideScopedEvaluator();
			evaluator.evaluateScript(template, "pre_script", {current : record});
		}
	},
	
	/* executePostScript
	************************************************************************************************************
	This function will execute the "Post-Script" as defined in the template.
	*/
	executePostScript : function(template, record) {
		if(template.getValue("execute_post_script") == true) {
			var evaluator = new GlideScopedEvaluator();
			evaluator.evaluateScript(template, "post_script", {current : record});
		}
	},
	
	/* fileName
	************************************************************************************************************
	This function will be called to generte the name of the file.
	*/
	fileName : function(template, record) {
		var fileName = template.getValue("default_file_name"), result = null;
		if(template.getValue("generate_filename_using_script") == true) {
			var evaluator = new GlideScopedEvaluator();
			evaluator.putVariable("result", result);
			evaluator.evaluateScript(template, "script_for_generating_the_filename", {current : record});
			result = evaluator.getVariable("result");
			fileName = (result != null && result != "undefined" && result != "") ? result : fileName;
		}
		return fileName;
	},
	
	/* createFileInstanceRecord
	************************************************************************************************************
	This function will be called to create a "File Instance Record".
	*/
	createFileInstanceRecord : function(template, record, type, result) {
		var gr = new GlideRecord("x_75740_inform_file_instance_record");
		gr.initialize();
		gr.setValue("type", type);
		gr.setValue("template_sys_id", template.getValue("sys_id"));
		gr.setValue("table", template.getValue("table"));
		gr.setValue("email_template", template.getValue("email_template"));
		gr.setValue("record_sys_id", record.getValue("sys_id"));
		gr.setValue("attachment_sys_id", result.attachment_id);
		gr.setValue("share_generated_file_over_email", template.getValue("share_the_generated_file_over_email"));
		gr.insert();
	},
	
	/* executeSchedule
	************************************************************************************************************
	This function will be called to execute a schedule to generate ZIP(s).
	*/
	executeSchedule : function(templateSysId) {
		var sysIds = [], query = "";
		var template = new GlideRecord("x_75740_inform_zip_template");
		template.addEncodedQuery("sys_id=" + templateSysId);
		template.query();
		if(template.next()) {
			if(template.getValue("filter_records_using_script") == true) {
				var evaluator = new GlideScopedEvaluator();
				evaluator.putVariable("result", null);
				evaluator.evaluateScript(template, "script_to_filter_the_records", {template : template});
				sysIds = evaluator.getVariable("result");
				query = "sys_idIN" + sysIds.toString();
			} else {
				query = template.getValue("filter");
			}
			
			var gr = new GlideRecord(template.getValue("table"));
			gr.addEncodedQuery(query);
			gr.query();
			while(gr.next()) {
				this.createZIP(templateSysId, gr);
			}
		}
	},
	
	type : 'ziputils'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2022-05-12 19:35:39</sys_created_on><sys_id>5ee832e707db0110a4a2f7108c1ed073</sys_id><sys_mod_count>23</sys_mod_count><sys_name>ziputils</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Inform" source="x_75740_inform">dc0f5e4007830110a4a2f7108c1ed060</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Inform">dc0f5e4007830110a4a2f7108c1ed060</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_5ee832e707db0110a4a2f7108c1ed073</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2022-05-16 13:55:07</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
